title: Psalm 119:11
passage: I have hidden your word in my heart that I might not sin against you.

title: Psalm 19:14
passage: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, O Lord, my rock and my redeemer.

title: Colossians 3:12-14 ESV
passage: Put on then, as God's chosen ones, holy and beloved, compassionate hearts, kindness, humility, meekness, and patience, bearing with one another and, if one has a complaint against another, forgiving each other; as the Lord has forgiven you, so you also must forgive. And above all these put on love, which binds everything together in perfect harmony.

title: 2 Corinthians 5:17 ESV
passage: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away; behold, the new has come.

title: 1 John 4:4 ESV
passage: Little children, you are from God and have overcome them, for he who is in you is greater than he who is in the world.

title: Psalm 27:1 ESV
passage: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

title: Isaiah 41:10 ESV
passage: Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.

title: Jeremiah 29:11 ESV
passage: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans for welfare and not for evil, to give you a future and a hope.

title: Romans 6:6 ESV
passage: We know that our old self was crucified with him in order that the body of sin might be brought to nothing, so that we would no longer be enslaved to sin.

title: Romans 8:1 ESV
passage: There is therefore now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.

title: Galatians 5:1 ESV
passage: For freedom Christ has set us free; stand firm therefore, and do not submit again to a yoke of slavery.

title: 1 Peter 2:1-3 ESV
passage: So put away all malice and all deceit and hypocrisy and envy and all slander. Like newborn infants, long for the pure spiritual milk, that by it you may grow up into salvation-if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is good.

title: John 8:36 ESV
passage: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.

title: Colossians 1:13-14 ESV
passage: He has delivered us from the domain of darkness and transferred us to the kingdom of his beloved Son, in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.

title: Psalm 37:30-31 ESV
passage: The mouth of the righteous utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice. The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not slip.

title: 2 Timothy 1:6-7 ESV
passage: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands, for God gave us a spirit not of fear but of power and love and self-control.

title: John 8:31-32 ESV
passage: So Jesus said to the Jews who had believed him, 'If you abide in my word, you are truly my disciples, and you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.
